references.note: The shipped flat Gorbat, Supreme Wyrmic of the Pride token: copy its matte painted miniature finish, colours and value structure. Ignore its top-down camera and its physical disc entirely - the standee has no disc.
Native Gorbat, Supreme Wyrmic of the Pride sprite: keep the same species, gear, colours and markings, converted to a true upright standing/rearing composition.
The nearest mapped family token. It shares this creature's body plan or palette, so it is the token this one must stay clearly distinct from; do not copy its pose.

prompt_fields.subject: Gorbat, Supreme Wyrmic of the Pride: a huge green-skinned orc wyrmic, bare muscular torso crossed with draconic scales, large leathery wings folded from the shoulders, a snarling tusked face and a jagged blade. Keep the native olive-green skin, the dark wing membranes and the same held weapon.
prompt_fields.contrast: Taller than wide: stand at full height with the wings raised high behind the shoulders and the blade held down at one side. Do not spread the wings sideways below shoulder height into a low disc.
prompt_fields.composition: Full body, upright standing three-quarter view, wings swept up behind the head, feet planted, head near the top of the frame. Overall height to width about 1.7 to 1.
prompt_fields.palette: olive-green orc skin, dark green-brown wing membrane, dull steel blade, bone-white tusks.
